title: Wansford in England
subtitle: Wansford Walk
welcome_text: [[c:A mystery walk around Wansford, its old stone bridge and the Great North Road, home of the famous haycock legend.]]
start_text: [[c:Start at the Haycock, by the old bridge.]]

coins.explain: [[c:You have a purse of 5 coins for the whole walk. Hints are free. Showing an answer costs coins.]]

layers.label: Mystery story
layers.description: [[c:The story and the puzzles. Switch it off for a history-only walk.]]

route.name: The Cross Keys and the old chapel
route.label: Cross Keys

story: [[c:Wansford, 1724. Coaches thunder along the Great North Road, and everyone at the inn is laughing about Barnaby, who swears he fell asleep on a haycock, floated down the Nene and woke up asking 'Wansford in England?']]
[[c:While everyone was laughing, the strongbox from the London coach went missing from the inn yard.]]

[[c:Four people were about: Barnaby Hale, the farmhand with the haycock story; Nell Briggs, the innkeeper's wife; Ned Turpin, the coach guard (no relation to the highwayman, he says); and Signor Rossi, a travelling showman. Find the strongbox before the coach leaves.]]

start_page.title: Getting to the start
start_page.intro: [[c:The walk starts and finishes at the Haycock, beside the old bridge over the Nene.]]
parking: [[c:Parking: please park considerately on the village streets, or ask at the pub. If you're driving, park first and then open the walk.]]
start_page.support: [[c:Support the village: Wansford has pubs and places to eat. The walk takes about 45 minutes to 1 hour 15.]]
